{"topic":"app-manual","bytes":3015,"guide":"## SETTINGS, ACCOUNT AND CREDITS — Account, usage, AI tools (Studio Agent, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT images), Storage and moving projects, Generation logs, sign-in, buying credits

### Settings: AI tools — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, CLI, any MCP tool (Connect, Copy)
The boxed list **AI tools** has six rows.
| Row | Button | What it does | Agent op |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Claude Desktop** | **Connect** | Adds a `slates` entry to Claude Desktop's config file, keeping a `.bak`; needs Node's `npx` on the PATH | only you |
| **Claude Code** | **Connect** | Runs `claude mcp add slates -s user -- npx -y @slatesvideo/mcp-server` | only you |
| **Cursor** | **Connect** | Adds a `slates` entry to `~/.cursor/mcp.json`, keeping a `.bak` | only you |
| **Codex (ChatGPT)** | **Copy** | Copies `codex mcp add slates -- npx -y @slatesvideo/mcp-server`; the button reads **Copied** for two seconds | only you |
| **Slates CLI** | **Copy** | Copies `npm i -g @slatesvideo/cli` | only you |
| **Any other tool** | **Copy** | Copies `npx -y @slatesvideo/mcp-server` | only you |

**Connect** shows only when the tool is found on this computer; otherwise the row reads **Not installed**. After it works the row reads **Added. Restart it to load Slates**: restart that tool. **Setup guide** under the list opens slates.video/docs/connect-claude. A failure shows under the row name: see Settings: messages you may see (AI tools).

## USING SLATES FROM YOUR OWN AI — Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex (ChatGPT), the MCP server, the Slates CLI

### Your own AI: connect Claude, Cursor or Codex (set up the MCP)

1. Titlebar → **Settings** → **AI tools**. Under **Use Slates from Claude, Cursor or Codex**, the first line says **Connected** or **Not connected yet**.
2. Check the email and press **Send link**. Open the email and the link; confirm the code the page shows if it asks. The line turns to **Connected** by itself (the wait lasts 10 minutes and keeps going with Settings closed).
3. In the tools list: **Connect** beside **Claude Desktop**, **Claude Code** or **Cursor** adds Slates to that app (restart it after: **Added. Restart it to load Slates**). For **Codex (ChatGPT)**, the Slates CLI or **Any other tool**, press **Copy** and run the command.
4. **Disconnect** on the first line signs your AI tools out of your account and stops the connection.

The ChatGPT app itself does not connect; Codex, OpenAI's agent that runs with your ChatGPT sign-in, does. Help for each tool: **Setup guide** (slates.video/docs/connect-claude).

Related sections (ask by heading): USING SLATES FROM YOUR OWN AI — Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex (ChatGPT), the MCP server, the Slates CLI · Settings: how to connect Claude, Cursor or Codex to Slates · Settings: AI tools — connect Claude, Cursor or Codex by email link (Send link, Disconnect) · Studio Agent: model and where it thinks (what runs it, Slates free, ChatGPT plan through Codex, Claude plan through Claude Code, thinking level)"}

**You're already connected.** Slates is running as an MCP server in this Claude Code session and I can see your workspace: two projects, **Morning Ritual Coffee** (5 assets, updated yesterday) and **Bakery launch** (empty). You don't need to set anything up.

For reference, or if you set this up on another computer, this is how you connect:

1. In the Slates app, open **Settings** from the titlebar, then **AI tools**.
2. Under **Use Slates from Claude, Cursor or Codex**, check that the email is right and press **Send link**. Open the link in the email and confirm the code if the page asks for one. The status line changes from **Not connected yet** to **Connected** on its own.
3. In the tools list, press **Connect** next to **Claude Code**. This runs:
   ```
   claude mcp add slates -s user -- npx -y @slatesvideo/mcp-server
   ```
   You can also run that command yourself in a terminal. Node's `npx` needs to be on your PATH.
4. When the row says **Added. Restart it to load Slates**, restart Claude Code.

If the row says **Not installed** instead of showing a **Connect** button, Slates didn't find Claude Code on that computer, so run the command above by hand. **Disconnect** on the first line signs your AI tools out. The **Setup guide** link (slates.video/docs/connect-claude) has help for each tool.

**What I can do with it:** write and break down scripts, make shots and storyboards, manage characters, environments and styles, edit timelines, and export. Generating images or video costs real credits. Before I generate anything, I'll price each step and show you the total, and I'll wait for your OK.

Which project should I work in, and what would you like to make?
